sources.title: Phase Ib Study of Pembrolizumab in Combination with Intratumoral Injection of  Clostridium novyi -NT in Patients with Advanced Solid Tumors
sources.conditions: One generic myxoid chondrosarcoma among16 participants (cohort2 n4); not automatically extraskeletal NR4A3 EMC. Separate preclinical H-EMC-SS label does not authenticate clinical donor.
sources.measurement: SupplementS3 releases all16 donor IDs, injected baseline site/size, priorIO/MSI/TMB, but no histology or serial lesion dimensions.
